verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Fireworks has an official CLI (`firectl`) used to deploy LoRA models and manage deployments, confirming a CLI exists, but the evidence pack contains only a single command reference with no broader documentation of CLI capabilities, installation, or AI-native workflow support. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI docs/reference, installation/onboarding guide, full command coverage (training, inference, model management), independent/hands-on validation.
